entries.sourcePrefix: Collect the clues and explore the scenarios
entries.text:
Collect clues and explore the area to complete the level. Look for icons that mark interaction points.

Avoiding lethal force may help you earn people's trust. The consequences of your actions will persist throughout the game.

Primary Objective
	Explore the area
Secondary Objective
	Help the person

entries.sourcePrefix: In 2239, a massive energy crisis devastated the world.
entries.text:
In 2239, a massive energy crisis devastated the world. Major cities, corporations, and the population alike suffered severely from the lack of power.

The world plunged into chaos. Ten years of scarcity followed, and more than 60% of the global population perished. The first spark of light came from an organization called Lumen, dedicated to resolving conflicts and restoring the basic functioning of society.

This journey of reconstruction is now approaching its 200th year, yet the vision of a "perfect utopia" already seems to have faded away... Recent rumors suggest that Lumen is being sabotaged. True or not, I've been assigned to investigate these claims.

The nearest port should hold information on the corporations operating undercover on this side of the city. Better go check it out...
I'm here to find information about corporations operating in this area, possibly undercover. Time to look around and talk to some people. It could be anything — documents, data pads, data shards...
This person has information about how to access a nearby corporate building, but he's asking for help finding his missing picture first... I hope this information is worth it...
The man told me about a local worker's house. It seems he has access to a side door of a nearby warehouse... With some luck, he'll have a spare key I could use.
I found the documents. Time to move. I need to get back to my car — I parked it near the entrance, where I met John.

A damaged piece of paper. I can barely read it. It says: "Hey, ... I left it on top of an orange box, near the side gate ... the other key ... don't lose this one or I ..." The rest is a string of insults. Letters leave no digital trace, but the paper itself might be traceable... Something is wrong here...
In a highly digital world, someone decided to keep a physical memento of a happy moment. The owner of the photo must have a strong connection to it — they'll probably be grateful to have it back.
Test content. Replace this clue before release.
A key used to unlock large automatic doors. If John's information is true, it could provide access to a nearby warehouse.

Documents about shipments to several places. A particularly large volume went to a recycling company in this district. The documents don't say what's in those boxes — unlike the other shipments... Too much cargo to be "just tools" like the others...

I should probably go there next. A recycling company receiving so many unregistered shipments? Even if it's not related to the case, it's worth a look.
I'm John. I live here and work downtown. I didn't do anything wrong.
Do you know anything about this place?
Maybe. They took a memento of my daughter — help me get it back and I'll tell you everything I know. The guy works around the checkpoints between the two big warehouses.

Thank you. I saw a man who works at a nearby warehouse walk into a house near a red container bar with a black container on top. Then he vanished. I know for sure that it's not a regular warehouse. Armed guards who shoot on sight if you get too close? Very suspicious...
I'm John. Please leave me alone. I don't know them. I saw nothing. Don't kill me. Please...
